assumptions: Aliquots a-c of a core are pseudoreplicates; core is the experimental unit, so counts were summed per core (300 specimens) and converted to relative abundances, n=6 cores (3 per zone).
Bray-Curtis PERMANOVA on core-level data; exact permutation over 20 core labelings gives p=0.100 (minimum attainable 0.1).
issues: Treating 18 aliquots as independent would inflate n and give pseudo-replicated F (8.034, R2 0.334); not used.
With only 6 cores the permutation test has low power.
summary: Pooled aliquots per core, Bray-Curtis on relative abundances, one-way PERMANOVA by zone with n=6 cores.
